title: ENS DAO Newsletter #123 - 11/1/2026
headline: ENS newsletter lists ENSv2 activation as executed, a Meta-Governance Working Group Term 7 funding request of 201,559 USDC as passed, and new draft IPS amendments and ENSv2 pricing temp checks.
summary: The 1 November newsletter reports proposal statuses. Listed as executed: Activate ENSv2, which freezes new v1 .eth registrations, keeps unmigrated names renewable and shifts registration and resolution to v2, with Labs handing v2 admin roles to the DAO after launch. Listed with vote pending: an upgrade of the DNSSEC oracle and registrar after the 2026 root KSK rollover. The Meta-Governance Working Group Term 7 funding request (201,559 USDC for 3 stewards, communications, governance costs and approved contract audits) is listed as passed, with a matching executable proposal pending. A proposal to select OpenZeppelin to audit Governor Nexus is listed with a pending Snapshot result. Temp checks and drafts include IPS Amendment No. 1 (covered options writing in Endowment rebalancing), IPS Amendment No. 2 (moving IPS amendment authority from the Meta-Governance Working Group to the Foundation Board, with a 7-day forum review and DAO veto), and a proposal to remove price cliffs in ENSv2 registration pricing. Updates also cover the ENS Labs Q3 report, the ENS Foundation being approved as an operating entity, and a Devcon Mumbai collectibles event on November 3.
risk_flags: proposed change to investment policy authority
